policyEndpoint.title: Policy pull endpoint (GET). Leave empty to use managed policy only.

maxStageAgeHours.title: Hard purge age for staged text

token.title: Shared token (must match DLP_TOKEN on the server)

workstationTag.title: Workstation/user tag stamped on flagged events (set per machine by IT). Preferred attribution source; the only one that works on Firefox.

unknownSiteMode.title: Mode for AI sites found by discovery but not in the catalog

coverage.title: catalog = known AI sites only; discover = also score unknown pages heuristically (requires broad host permission)

stageMode.title: all = stage every prompt for nightly review; flagged-only = stage only prompts with findings

allowServerExemptions.title: Permit the policy endpoint to push rule exemptions. Default false: a remotely pushable exemption is a remote off switch.

group.title: Department/OU name selecting a groupPolicies entry

groupPolicies.title: Per-group policy overlays, keyed by group name

categoryModes.title: Mode per site category (public_chat, enterprise_ai, code_ai, doc_ai, writing_ai, media_ai, meeting_ai, search_ai, platform, agent_ai)

siteOverrides.title: Mode per site id (or bare hostname for discovered sites)

extraSites.title: AI sites to cover in addition to the shipped catalog

disabledSites.title: Catalog site ids to stop covering

exemptRules.title: Detection rule ids to exempt fleet-wide (still detected and logged, not enforced)

exemptRulesBySite.title: Rule ids exempted per site id or hostname

neverScan.title: Hostname globs never inspected, in any mode. Banking, payroll, and health portals belong here.
